name: Multikarya Asia Pasifik Raya Tb
summary: PT Multikarya Asia Pasifik Raya Tbk specializes in delivering essential equipment and support services to the oil and gas industry, particularly aiding drilling and production operations. The company's diverse product portfolio features reciprocating pumps, components and expendables for mud and centrifugal pumps, various industrial valves such as butterfly and gate valves, robust solid control systems, and handling tools. Beyond its product offerings, Multikarya Asia Pasifik Raya Tbk provides critical support through equipment rental, comprehensive repair, and ongoing maintenance services. The firm was established on May 16, 2002, and its principal offices are located in Jakarta, Indonesia.
